title: salix aurita var. uliginosa
intro: Salix aurita var. uliginosa, commonly known as Marsh Willow, is a variety of shrub or small tree that belongs to the willow family (Salicaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, which have been used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Marsh Willow include relieving pain, reducing inflammation, and treating wounds, due to its high concentration of salicylic acid, a bioactive constituent with analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Marsh Willow include acting as an analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic agent, with its bioactive constituents including salicin, salicylic acid, and flavonoids.
